text: This report requests Council's authority for the City to assume the municipal road and services within Mantello Drive, in accordance with the terms of the Subdivision Agreement for Plan 66M-2493, registered on December 1, 2011 between University Square (Hucknall) Limited and the City of Toronto.
Etobicoke York Community Council referred this Item back to the Director, Engineering Review, Engineering and Construction Services, for further consultation with the Ward Councillor.
